data.name: VBCompileError_DirectiveWithoutIf_Verbose
data.value: This #End If ends no #If block: there is none before it, or the #If before it is not a directive (it needs an expression and Then, and nothing after Then but a comment).

data.name: VBCompileError_HashElseWithoutIf_Verbose
data.value: This #Else belongs to no #If block, or is the second #Else of its block.

data.name: VBCompileError_ElseIfWithoutIf_Verbose
data.value: This #ElseIf belongs to no #If block, or comes after the #Else of its block.

data.name: VBCompileError_HashIfWithoutEndIf_Verbose
data.value: This #If block is not ended: the module ends before its #End If.

data.name: VBCompileError_ExpressionNestedTooDeeply_Verbose
data.value: This expression is nested in more than 2,500 others. Write part of it to a variable first.

data.name: VBCompileError_ModuleNestedTooDeeplyToRead_Verbose
data.value: This module is nested too deeply to be read: an expression or a block in it is nested in many thousands of others. Split its deepest part into smaller ones.

data.name: VBCompileError_OutputItemsNotSeparated_Verbose
data.value: This output item is written right after another, with nothing between them. The VBE would write a ; between them, which prints them the same way.

data.name: VBCompileError_DirectiveExpectedThen_Verbose
data.value: Expected: Then. An #If or #ElseIf directive is written #If expression Then.

data.name: VBCompileError_DirectiveExpectedExpression_Verbose
data.value: Expected: expression. The condition of an #If or #ElseIf directive is a constant expression of literals, conditional-compilation constants and operators.

data.name: VBCompileError_DirectiveExpectedEndOfStatement_Verbose
data.value: Expected: end of statement. Nothing but a comment may follow a directive on its line.

data.name: VBCompileError_DirectiveExpectedKeyword_Verbose
data.value: Expected: If or Else or ElseIf or End or EndIf or Const. A line that starts with # is a directive.

data.name: VBCompileError_ConstDirectiveExpectedEquals_Verbose
data.value: Expected: =. A #Const directive is written #Const name = expression.

data.name: VBCompileError_ConstDirectiveExpectedName_Verbose
data.value: Expected: identifier. A #Const directive is written #Const name = expression.

data.name: VBCompileError_ConstDirectiveExpression_Verbose
data.value: Expected: expression. The value of a #Const directive is a constant expression of literals, conditional-compilation constants and operators.

data.name: VBCompileError_ReservedDeclarationName_Verbose
data.value: Expected: identifier. '{0}' is a reserved word and cannot name a declaration.

data.name: VBCompileError_ReservedParameterName_Verbose
data.value: Expected: identifier. '{0}' is a reserved word and cannot name a parameter.

data.name: VBCompileError_TooManyLineContinuations_Verbose
data.value: Too many line continuations: a logical line joins at most 25 physical lines, with 24 line-continuations.

data.name: VBCompileError_NumericLiteralOverflow_Verbose
data.value: The numeric literal's value is outside the range of its type.

data.name: VBCompileError_RaiseEventByVal_Verbose
data.value: A RaiseEvent argument cannot be written with ByVal: the keyword is valid only in the argument list of an external procedure's invocation (MS-VBAL §5.6.13.1).

data.name: VBCompileError_CallArgumentsNeedCall_Verbose
data.value: A call that is not written with the Call keyword does not have an argument list in parentheses, not even an empty one. Drop the parentheses (Foo 1, 2 or Foo), or write the Call keyword (Call Foo(1, 2) or Call Foo()). The parentheses of a single argument are not an argument list but the grouping of that argument, which is passed by value (MS-VBAL §5.4.2.1).
